title: OLX.ba Exits & Price Endings
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event dates and reported daily prices rather than reconstructed inventory.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT property_type AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE property_type IS NOT NULL AND property_type <> 'daily_rent' ORDER BY 1

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exits · 30 d
panels.description: Listings that left OLX. An exit is not a confirmed sale.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT count(*) AS closed_30d FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30

panels.title: Median final KM/m² · sales · 30 d
panels.description: Last observed asking price per m² before the exit.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median_exit_ppm2 FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 AND closing_ppm2>0

panels.title: Exit share · 30 d
panels.description: Exits as a share of exits plus current actives.

panels.title: Median final asking KM/m² by exit day · sales
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT closed_at::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY closing_ppm2)::numeric,0) AS "median exit KM/m²" FROM base WHERE ${time_filter:closed_at} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Final ask vs opening ask · 90 d
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT CASE WHEN b.closing_price<opening.opening_price THEN 'lower' WHEN b.closing_price>opening.opening_price THEN 'higher' ELSE 'same' END AS direction,count(*) AS listings FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE WHERE b.closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90 AND b.closing_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Exit share by KM/m² band · sales · 30 d
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT (ppm2_bracket/1000)||'–'||(ppm2_bracket/1000+1)||'k' AS ppm2_band,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT (floor(closing_ppm2/1000)*1000)::int AS ppm2_bracket,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 AND closing_ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT (floor(ppm2/1000)*1000)::int,0,count(*) FROM active WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY ppm2_bracket ORDER BY ppm2_bracket

panels.title: Days listed vs final price change
panels.description: Change from the cycle's opening ask to its final ask. Changes beyond −50% / +100% are left out as likely data errors. Click a dot to open the ad.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT b.days_listed::float8 AS days_listed, (100.0*(b.closing_price/opening.opening_price-1))::float8 AS final_change_pct,b.title,b.url,b.article_id FROM base b JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price AS opening_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE article_id=b.article_id AND source='api_price_history' AND price>0 AND price_date <= b.closed_at ORDER BY CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,CASE WHEN price_date >= b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END ASC NULLS LAST,CASE WHEN price_date < b.cycle_opened_at THEN price_date END DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1) opening ON TRUE WHERE b.closing_price IS NOT NULL AND b.closing_price BETWEEN 0.5*opening.opening_price AND 2*opening.opening_price

panels.title: Exit map · 90 d
panels.description: Sale pins are colored by final asking KM/m²; rentals are gray. Click a pin to open the ad.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT latitude,longitude,title,url,closing_price,closing_ppm2,days_listed FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 90 AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Recent exits
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title,url,neighborhood,rooms,sqm,closing_price AS final_asking_price,closing_ppm2,cycle_opened_at,closed_at,round(days_listed::numeric,1) AS days_listed FROM base ORDER BY closed_at DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Exit share by neighborhood · 30 d
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.article_id,e.title,e.url,e.deal,e.property_type,e.sqm,e.rooms,e.neighborhood,e.latitude,e.longitude,e.price AS closing_price,e.occurred_at AS closed_at,e.opened_at AS cycle_opened_at,CASE WHEN e.sqm>0 AND e.deal='sale' THEN e.price/e.sqm END AS closing_ppm2,(e.occurred_at-e.opened_at) AS days_listed FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal}='All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR e.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), active AS (SELECT l.article_id,l.deal,l.property_type,l.rooms,l.sqm,l.ppm2,l.neighborhood FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal}='All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal=CASE WHEN ${deal}='sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category}='All' OR l.property_type=${category}) AND (${rooms}='All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown')=${rooms}) AND ('All'=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown')=ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT neighborhood,sum(exits) AS exits_30d,sum(actives) AS active,round(100.0*sum(exits)/NULLIF(sum(exits)+sum(actives),0),1) AS exit_ratio FROM (SELECT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS neighborhood,count(*) AS exits,0::bigint AS actives FROM base WHERE closed_at > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown'),0,count(*) FROM active GROUP BY 1) population GROUP BY neighborhood ORDER BY exits_30d DESC, exit_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
